-- AAC Phase 1H
-- Auto-approve doctor reviews whose configured deadline has expired.
CREATE TEMP TABLE expired_reviews AS
SELECT
  ap.approval_id,
  ap.article_id,
  ap.deadline,
  a.doctor_id,
  a.campaign_id,
  a.current_version,
  c.require_marketing_approval
FROM `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.approvals` ap
JOIN `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.articles` a
  ON a.article_id = ap.article_id
JOIN `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.campaigns` c
  ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
WHERE ap.approval_type = 'DOCTOR_REVIEW'
  AND ap.status = 'PENDING'
  AND COALESCE(ap.deadline, a.doctor_review_deadline) <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()
  AND a.status = 'DOCTOR_REVIEW_PENDING'
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ap.article_id ORDER BY ap.requested_at DESC) = 1;

MERGE `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.approvals` T
USING expired_reviews S
ON T.approval_id = S.approval_id
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET
  status = 'AUTO_APPROVED',
  responded_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(),
  response = 'Automatically approved after the doctor review deadline expired.';

MERGE `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.article_review_links` T
USING expired_reviews S
ON T.article_id = S.article_id AND T.status IN ('READY', 'OPENED')
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET
  status = 'EXPIRED',
  responded_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP();

MERGE `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.articles` T
USING expired_reviews S
ON T.article_id = S.article_id
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET
  status = 'DOCTOR_AUTO_APPROVED',
  doctor_approved_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP();

MERGE `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.campaign_doctors` T
USING expired_reviews S
ON T.campaign_id = S.campaign_id AND T.doctor_id = S.doctor_id
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET
  status = 'DOCTOR_AUTO_APPROVED',
  updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP();

INSERT INTO `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.workflow_events`
(event_id, entity_type, entity_id, event_type, event_timestamp, source_system, workflow_execution_id, payload)
SELECT
  GENERATE_UUID(),
  'article',
  article_id,
  'doctor.auto_approved',
  CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(),
  'n8n:doctor-review-deadline',
  NULL,
  TO_JSON(STRUCT(
    approval_id,
    deadline,
    current_version AS version_number,
    IF(require_marketing_approval, 'MARKETING_REVIEW', 'PUBLISHING') AS next_stage
  ))
FROM expired_reviews;

SELECT
  article_id,
  doctor_id,
  campaign_id,
  current_version,
  deadline,
  'DOCTOR_AUTO_APPROVED' AS status,
  IF(require_marketing_approval, 'MARKETING_REVIEW', 'PUBLISHING') AS next_stage
FROM expired_reviews;

parameters.content:
## AAC Phase 1H - Five-Day Auto-Approval

Runs hourly and converts expired pending doctor reviews to `DOCTOR_AUTO_APPROVED`. The workflow expires active review links, records an explicit `AUTO_APPROVED` approval result, updates campaign state, and writes a `doctor.auto_approved` audit event.

The output identifies whether Phase 1I marketing review or Phase 1J publishing is next. Connect the existing **Google BigQuery account** credential before publishing this workflow.
